name: campaign-engine
description: Campaign Engine module for the CXL AI Native Marketer cohort: brief in, reviewed campaign out. Commands for the brief, channels, drafts, review, quality gate and the campaigns board, eight starter channel workflows built from CXL courses, and /campaign-engine:setup to add the module to your personal OS and coach you through a campaign. Works on its own; reads the brand brain from the marketing-brain plugin when it is there.
